'''Brooser''' was a large, simian looking [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. At a height of 2.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighing over 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], his bulk consisted of all muscle except for a [[Jargridian Brandy]] belly around his middle. Brooser was easily provoked and had a passion for fighting and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. Nonetheless, he loved his girlfriend, [[Jezzable]], above all else. However, Jezzable's flirtatious attitude toward other males aggravated Brooser's jealousy and penchant for physical violence.

==Biography==
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]<ref name="TRP" /> between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="age" /> Brooser was a thirty-seven-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Brooser garnered the most joy from fighting, reveling in the slightest provocation, with a zeal for [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] a close second. More than his vices, though, he loved his girlfriend, [[Jezzable]].<ref name="TRP" /> However, her blatantly coquettish manner with the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who traveled through their home of [[Celanon City]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|161|Jezzable}}</ref> drove him to the zenith of jealousy.<ref name="TRP" />

{{RPGseed}}
One afternoon, Brooser was present at [[Gularg's Libation Emporium]], a local [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] establishment, when he noticed that Jezzable was assiduously flirting with a newly arrived [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Having decided that he didn't like the look of the smuggler, Brooser provoked a brawl, in which the other patrons soon joined. The fracas continued until [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] were drawn. At that point, [[Gularg]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] owner of the locale&mdash;and an individual who did not condone the use of firearms in his bar&mdash;disarmed the opponents and ended the altercation.<ref name="TRP" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Brooser was a strong, tough working-class man who took pleasure in fighting. Brooser was easily agitated and provoked into displays of violence, especially by Jezzable's provocative actions toward males of all [[Species/Legends|species]]. Some individuals found Brooser's physical appearance to be anomalous in regard to a standard Human. Standing at a height of 2.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighing over 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], Brooser was a large man&mdash;considerably simian in appearance&mdash;whose mass consisted of all muscle, except for a protruding belly gained from the consumption of [[Jargridian Brandy]]. At one point, a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Jorgan Blech]] compared Brooser to a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. What was left of the hapless captain after Brooser was finished with him was then pummeled by a Wookiee for insulting his people.<ref name="TRP" />

==Skills and abilities==
The street-smart Brooser was skilled in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fighting]] and blocking with his bare [[Limb/Legends|hands]], and with [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. He was a strong man with good stamina and lifting ability. Brooser was also proficient in gambling.<ref name="TRP" />

==Equipment==
Brooser wore work [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] and owned [[Brass knuckles/Legends|brass knuckles]].<ref name="TRP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Politics-of-contraband.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Brooser was created for "The Right Place ...," first published in ''Politics of Contraband''.]]
Brooser first appeared in "[[The Right Place ...]]," an adventure scenario written by [[Bill Olmesdahl|William Olmesdahl]] for ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRP" />

Although Brooser is a character who appears in "The Right Place ..." and can be approached by a player's character, it is the Gamemaster's discretion as to whether the player will participate in the mini-scenario "Punched out!," in which Brooser will brawl with a player. However, if it is decided that the scenario will be used, the scenario "Flirtatious advance," in which Jezzable flirts with the player, must be presented first, as "Punched out!" is the conclusion to "Flirtatious advance."<ref name="TRP" />

Brooser's character template type is given as "Tough Native" in ''The Politics of Contraband'',<ref name="TRP" /> which is not one of the standard templates found in ''The Roleplaying Game''. However, as it is possible for a player to create a new template for their own individual characters, "Tough Native" may be used as an example template in generating a unique template or character.<ref name="RPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref><ref name="RPG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="RPG2EE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
